title: prunus itosakura var. subhirtella
intro: Prunus itosakura var. subhirtella, commonly known as the 'Fugen-zakura' or ' Japanese Hill Cherry', is a species of cherry tree native to Japan. This plant is known for its beautiful pink flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving coughs, and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Prunus itosakura var. subhirtella include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
